summary: üWave is a self-hosted platform designed for collaborative listening sessions. It allows multiple users to take turns queuing and playing media from external sources such as YouTube and SoundCloud within a shared virtual space.
goodFor: It suits small communities or groups of friends who want to host a private, synchronized online room to share and queue music or video clips together.
watchOut: The project has a very low public profile with zero tagged releases or recorded recent commits, meaning you may encounter bugs or lack community support during setup.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy like Nginx or Caddy to handle TLS termination and manage persistent state using an external database.
